```{r fonctions-utiles, include=FALSE }
extraire_annee_semaine <- function(data, colonne_periode = "periodname") {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      period_txt = .data[[colonne_periode]],
      semaine = suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(period_txt, "(?<=Week\\s)\\d+|(?<=W)\\d+|\\b\\d{1,2}\\b"))),
      date_fin = suppressWarnings(ymd(str_extract(period_txt, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$"))),
      annee = suppressWarnings(year(date_fin)),
      annee = if_else(is.na(annee), suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(period_txt, "\\b20\\d{2}\\b"))), annee)
    ) %>%
    select(-period_txt)
}

convertir_numerique <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace_all(as.character(x), "\\s", "")))
}

format_fr <- label_comma(big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",")
```

# Dernière semaine rapportée et complétude des données

```{r derniere-semaine-palu, include=FALSE }
avd_semaine_2026 <- palu %>%
  filter(annee == 2026, !is.na(cas_palu)) %>%
  summarise(max_sem = max(semaine -1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_sem)


derniere_semaine_2026 <- palu %>%
  filter(annee == 2026, !is.na(cas_palu)) %>%
  summarise(max_sem = max(semaine, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_sem)

if (!is.finite(derniere_semaine_2026)) {
  stop("Aucune donnée paludisme disponible pour 2026 avec cas non manquants.")
}

```
Les données de ce bulletin proviennent de la compilation centralisée des données issues des formations sanitaires (publique, privée et confessionnelle) des 56 District sanitaires (DS) à travers le pays. Cette compilation est faite par le Service de Surveillance épidémiologique de la Direction du Système National d’information Sanitaire (DSNIS) du Burundi et rapporté dans le DHIS2. La dernière semaine rapporté est la semaine épidmiologique `r derniere_semaine_2026`.



``` {r Completude, include=FALSE }
# CALCUL DE LA COMPLETUDE HEBDOMADAIRE PAR DISTRICT
dsnis_weekly <- read_excel( path = "dsnis_weekly.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>%  clean_names()

# 3. Sélectionner les colonnes nécessaires
base_completude <- dsnis_weekly %>% select(districts,semaine,nb_rap_attendus,nb_rap_recus)

# 4. Nettoyer et convertir les variables
base_completude <- base_completude %>% mutate(districts = str_squish(as.character(districts)),
    semaine = suppressWarnings(as.integer(semaine)),
    nb_rap_attendus = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nb_rap_attendus)),
    nb_rap_recus = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nb_rap_recus)) ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(districts), districts != "", !is.na(semaine))

# 5. Identifier automatiquement la dernière semaine rapportée
derniere_semaine <- base_completude %>% filter( !is.na(nb_rap_attendus) | !is.na(nb_rap_recus)) %>%
  summarise(derniere_semaine = max(semaine, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(derniere_semaine)

# 6. Filtrer les données de la dernière semaine rapportée
base_derniere_semaine <- base_completude %>%  filter(semaine == derniere_semaine)

# 7. Calculer la complétude par district
# Formule :
# Complétude (%) = rapports reçus / rapports attendus × 100
# Le regroupement protège le calcul s'il existe plusieurs
# lignes pour un même district pendant la même semaine.
completude_district <- base_derniere_semaine %>%
  group_by(districts) %>%
  summarise(semaine = first(semaine),
    rapports_attendus = sum(nb_rap_attendus, na.rm = TRUE),
    rapports_recus = sum(nb_rap_recus,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(completude_pct = if_else(rapports_attendus > 0,  rapports_recus / rapports_attendus * 100,
      NA_real_),
    # Attribuer un statut à chaque district
    statut = case_when(
      is.na(completude_pct) ~ "Non calculable",
      completude_pct <= 80 ~ "Critique",
      completude_pct < 95 ~ "À améliorer",
      TRUE ~ "Satisfaisante")) %>%
  # Arrondir la complétude à une décimale
  mutate(completude_pct = round(completude_pct, 1)) %>%
  # Classer du district le moins complet au plus complet
  arrange(completude_pct)

# 8. Calculer la complétude globale
completude_globale <- completude_district %>%
  summarise(semaine = derniere_semaine,
    rapports_attendus = sum(rapports_attendus,  na.rm = TRUE),
    rapports_recus = sum(rapports_recus, na.rm = TRUE),
    completude_globale_pct = if_else(
      rapports_attendus > 0,
      rapports_recus / rapports_attendus * 100,
      NA_real_)) %>%
  mutate(completude_globale_pct = round(completude_globale_pct, 1))

# Afficher le résultat global
completude_globale

# 9. Sélectionner les districts à complétude critique
districts_critiques <- completude_district %>%
  filter(!is.na(completude_pct), completude_pct <= 80) %>%
  select(
    District = districts,
    Semaine = semaine,
    `Rapports attendus` = rapports_attendus,
    `Rapports reçus` = rapports_recus,
    `Complétude (%)` = completude_pct,
    Statut = statut) %>%
  arrange(`Complétude (%)`)

# Afficher le tableau
districts_critiques

```


```{r text_completude, include=FALSE}
cat(
  "À la semaine",
  completude_globale$semaine,
  ",",
  completude_globale$rapports_recus,
  "rapports ont été reçus sur",
  completude_globale$rapports_attendus,
  "rapports attendus, soit une complétude globale de",
  paste0(completude_globale$completude_globale_pct, "%."))

```
Au cours de la semaine  `r completude_globale$semaine` , `r completude_globale$rapports_recus` rapports ont été reçus sur `r completude_globale$rapports_attendus` rapports attendus, soit une complétude globale de `r paste0(completude_globale$completude_globale_pct)`%.



```{r aggregation-palu-national, include=FALSE}
palu_filtre <- palu %>%
  filter(
    annee %in% 2021:2026,
    !is.na(semaine),
    semaine >= 1,
    semaine <= 53
  ) %>%
  filter(annee != 2026 | semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026)

palu_week_year <- palu_filtre %>%
  group_by(annee, semaine) %>%
  summarise(cas = sum(cas_palu, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(annee, semaine)

seuils <- palu_week_year %>%
  filter(annee %in% 2021:2025) %>%
  group_by(semaine) %>%
  summarise(
    seuil_alerte = median(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
    seuil_epidemique = quantile(cas, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

graph_df <- palu_week_year %>%
  filter(annee %in% c(2025, 2026), semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026) %>%
  left_join(seuils, by = "semaine")

d2025 <- graph_df %>% filter(annee == 2025)
d2026 <- graph_df %>% filter(annee == 2026)
dseuils <- seuils %>% filter(semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026)
```
# Situation du paludisme au niveau national

**2.1. Suivi des seuils de surveillance et tendance hebdomadaire des cas en 2026 face à 2025**

```{r table-transposee-palu, include=FALSE}
table_annee_semaine <- palu_week_year %>%
  filter(annee %in% 2021:2026, semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026) %>%
  mutate(ligne = as.character(annee), semaine = paste0("S", semaine)) %>%
  select(ligne, semaine, cas) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = semaine, values_from = cas)

table_seuils <- seuils %>%
  filter(semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026) %>%
  mutate(semaine = paste0("S", semaine)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(seuil_alerte, seuil_epidemique), names_to = "ligne", values_to = "cas") %>%
  mutate(ligne = recode(
    ligne, 
    "seuil_alerte" = "Médiane_2021_2025", 
    "seuil_epidemique" = "Q3_2021_2025")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = semaine, values_from = cas)

tendance_2026_vs_2025 <- palu_week_year %>%
  filter(annee %in% c(2025, 2026), semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026) %>%
  select(annee, semaine, cas) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = annee, values_from = cas, names_prefix = "cas_") %>%
  mutate(tendance_pct = ifelse(is.na(cas_2025) | cas_2025 == 0, NA_real_, ((cas_2026 - cas_2025) / cas_2025) * 100))

ligne_tendance <- tendance_2026_vs_2025 %>%
  mutate(ligne = "Tendance_2026_vs_2025_pct", semaine = paste0("S", semaine), cas = round(tendance_pct, 1)) %>%
  select(ligne, semaine, cas) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = semaine, values_from = cas)


table_transposee <- bind_rows(table_annee_semaine, table_seuils, ligne_tendance)


tableau_seuil<- table_transposee %>%
  select(
    1, # première colonne
tail(names(.), 5))  %>% # cinq dernières colonnes
  mutate(ligne = case_when(
    ligne == "2021" ~ "2021",
    ligne == "2022" ~ "2022",
    ligne == "2023" ~ "2023",
    ligne == "2024" ~ "2024",
    ligne == "2025" ~ "2025",
    ligne == "2026" ~ "Année en cours",
    ligne == "Médiane_2021_2025" ~ "Seuil d'alerte",
    ligne == "Q3_2021_2025" ~ "Seuil épidemique",
    ligne == "Tendance_2026_vs_2025_pct" ~ "Tendance 2026 vs 2025"))

tendance1<- tableau_seuil[9, 2][[1]]
tendance2<- tableau_seuil[9, 6][[1]]

```

Au cours des semaines épidémiologiques `r names(tableau_seuil[2])` et `r names(tableau_seuil[6])`, les valeurs observées en 2026 sont restées largement inférieures aux seuils d’alerte et épidémiques. Comparativement à la même période en 2025, une baisse importante de cas de palusdisme est observée, variant de `r tendance1`% à  `r tendance2`%, sans indication de situation épidémique sur la période analysée comme réprésentée dans le **tableau I** suivant.

```{r tables-seuils, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tableau_seuil, caption = '**Tableau I: Cas hebdomadaires de paludisme des 5 dernières années et celle en cours au Burundi comparés aux seuils (alerte/Epidemique) et tendance 2026 vs 2025**')
```

**2.2. Courbe épidémique des cas en 2026 vs 2025 et seuils**

La courbe épidemique ci-dessous montre cette évolution hebdomadaire de ces cas de paludisme testé positif au niveau national depuis la SE1 2026 en comparaison de ceux de 2025 de la même période associant les courbe des seuils d’alerte et épidémique.

```{r graphique-palu-national, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.5, include=FALSE}
p_palu <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = d2025, 
           aes(x = semaine, y = cas, fill = "2025"), 
           color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7, width = 0.85) +
  geom_col(data = d2026, 
           aes(x = semaine, y = cas, fill = "2026"), 
           color = "midnightblue", alpha = 0.72, width = 0.60) +
  geom_line(data = dseuils, 
            aes(x = semaine, y = seuil_alerte, color = "Seuil d’alerte"), 
            linewidth = 1.05) +
  geom_line(data = dseuils, 
            aes(x = semaine, y = seuil_epidemique, color = "Seuil épidémique"), 
            linewidth = 1.05, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = dseuils, aes(x = semaine, y = seuil_alerte, color = "Seuil d’alerte"), size = 1.8) +
  geom_point(data = dseuils, aes(x = semaine, y = seuil_epidemique, color = "Seuil épidémique"), size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, derniere_semaine_2026, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = format_fr, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, breaks = c("2026", "2025"), values = c("2026" = "#2C7FB8", "2025" = "transparent"), labels = c("Cas de palu en 2026", "Cas de palu en 2025")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Seuil d’alerte" = "#08519C", "Seuil épidémique" = "#CB181D")) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Cas positifs de paludisme au Burundi : 2026 vs 2025, semaines 1–", derniere_semaine_2026),
    subtitle = "Seuil d’alerte = médiane 2021–2025 ; seuil épidémique = 3e quartile 2021–2025",
    x = "Semaine épidémiologique",
    y = "Nombre de cas positifs"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))



```

```{r, out.width='100%', fig.align='center', fig.cap='Graphique 1 : Évolution hebdomadaire des cas positifs de paludisme depuis la SE1 2026 comparés aux cas de 2025 au Burundi', echo=FALSE}
p_palu
```

**2.3. Courbe de variation des tendances des cas en 2026 vs 2025**

```{r graphique-tendance-palu, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.5, include=FALSE}
p_tendance <- ggplot(tendance_2026_vs_2025, aes(x = semaine, y = tendance_pct)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = tendance_pct >= 0), width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#CB181D", "FALSE" = "#238B45"), labels = c("FALSE" = "Baisse vs 2025", "TRUE" = "Hausse vs 2025"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, derniere_semaine_2026, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " %")) +
  labs(title = "Variation hebdomadaire des cas de paludisme : 2026 vs 2025", x = "Semaine épidémiologique", y = "Variation (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

La courbe épidemique ci-dessous montre la variation hebdomadaire de baisse des cas de positifs de paludisme de 2026 face à 2025 depuis la SE1 2026.

**2.4. Surveillance des alertes par district sanitaire**

```{r palu-districts, include=FALSE}
palu_clean <- palu %>%
  filter(!is.na(district_sanitaire), !is.na(semaine), !is.na(annee), annee %in% 2021:2026)

av_dern_semaine_2026 <- max(derniere_semaine_2026 - 1, 1)

palu_district_week <- palu_clean %>%
  filter(semaine <= derniere_semaine_2026) %>%
  group_by(district_sanitaire, annee, semaine) %>%
  summarise(cas = sum(cas_palu, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

palu_district_wide <- palu_district_week %>%
  mutate(annee = as.character(annee)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(district_sanitaire, semaine), names_from = annee, values_from = cas, names_prefix = "cas_")

for (col in paste0("cas_", 2021:2026)) {
  if (!col %in% names(palu_district_wide)) palu_district_wide[[col]] <- NA_real_
}

palu_district_alert <- palu_district_wide %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mediane_2021_2025 = median(c_across(c(cas_2021, cas_2022, cas_2023, cas_2024, cas_2025)), na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_2021_2025 = quantile(c_across(c(cas_2021, cas_2022, cas_2023, cas_2024, cas_2025)), probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7),
    variation_vs_mediane_pct = if_else(is.na(mediane_2021_2025) | mediane_2021_2025 == 0, NA_real_, ((cas_2026 - mediane_2021_2025) / mediane_2021_2025) * 100),
    variation_vs_q3_pct = if_else(is.na(q3_2021_2025) | q3_2021_2025 == 0, NA_real_, ((cas_2026 - q3_2021_2025) / q3_2021_2025) * 100)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    statut_2026 = case_when(
      is.na(cas_2026) ~ "Donnée 2026 manquante",
      cas_2026 > q3_2021_2025 ~ "Épidémie",
      cas_2026 > mediane_2021_2025 ~ "Alerte",
      TRUE ~ "Normal"
    )
  )

districts_alert_bef_last_week <- palu_district_alert %>%
  filter(semaine == derniere_semaine_2026) %>%
  arrange(factor(statut_2026, levels = c("Épidémie", "Alerte", "Normal", "Donnée 2026 manquante")), desc(cas_2026))

resume_statut_bef_last_week <- districts_alert_bef_last_week %>%
  count(statut_2026, name = "nombre_districts") %>%
  arrange(desc(nombre_districts))

top_districts_alert <- districts_alert_bef_last_week %>%
  filter(statut_2026 %in% c("Épidémie", "Alerte")) %>%
  arrange(desc(cas_2026)) %>%
  select(district_sanitaire, semaine, cas_2026, mediane_2021_2025, q3_2021_2025, statut_2026, variation_vs_mediane_pct, variation_vs_q3_pct)

statut_epi <- resume_statut_bef_last_week %>%
  rename(
    `Statut Epidémique` = statut_2026,
    `Nombre de district` = nombre_districts
  )

```

# Situation de l’ensemble des maladies à potentielle épidémique


```{r idsr-import, include=FALSE}
names(moh_dhis2) <- c(
  "districts", "semaine", "Cholera_CasTraites", "cholera_deces",
  "diarrh_sang__traites", "diarrh_sang_deces", "FHV_Test_positif",
  "FHV_Deces", "MPOX_CasSuspect", "PFA_Cas", "PFA_Deces", "palu_positifs",
  "palu_deces", "rougeole_suspect", "rougeole_deces", "TNN_CasSuspect", "TNN_Deces"
)

idsr <- moh_dhis2 %>%
  mutate(
    semaine_originale = semaine,
    num_semaine = as.integer(str_extract(semaine, "(?<=Week\\s)\\d+")),
    date_debut = ymd(str_extract(semaine, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}")),
    date_fin = ymd(str_extract(semaine, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$")),
    annee = year(date_fin)
  ) %>%
  relocate(districts, annee, num_semaine, date_debut, date_fin, semaine_originale)

surveillance <- idsr %>%
  select(districts, num_semaine, annee, palu_positifs, palu_deces, rougeole_suspect, rougeole_deces,
         MPOX_CasSuspect, FHV_Test_positif, FHV_Deces, diarrh_sang__traites, diarrh_sang_deces,
         Cholera_CasTraites, cholera_deces, PFA_Cas, PFA_Deces, TNN_CasSuspect, TNN_Deces) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(districts, num_semaine, annee), convertir_numerique)) %>%
  mutate(semaine = paste0(annee, "-W", sprintf("%02d", num_semaine))) %>%
  select(-annee)
```

**2.1. Tableau synthétique des trois dernières semaines et cumul**

```{r tableau-idsr, include=FALSE}
MPE_SE <- surveillance %>%
  arrange(semaine) %>%
  group_by(semaine) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

total_cas <- surveillance %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

MPE_SE <- bind_rows(MPE_SE, total_cas) %>%
  mutate(semaine = case_when(is.na(semaine) ~ "Total", TRUE ~ semaine))

SE_3D <- bind_rows(
  MPE_SE %>% filter(semaine != "Total") %>% arrange(semaine) %>% slice_tail(n = 3),
  MPE_SE %>% filter(semaine == "Total")
)

tab1 <- SE_3D %>%
  select(-num_semaine) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -semaine, names_to = "name", values_to = "value")

tab2 <- tab1 %>% pivot_wider(names_from = semaine, values_from = value)

tab3 <- tab2 %>%
  mutate(
    name = tolower(name),
    name = case_when(
      name == "diarrh_sang__traites" ~ "diarrsang_traites",
      name == "diarrh_sang_deces" ~ "diarrsang_deces",
      TRUE ~ name
    )
  ) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("Disease", "Type"), sep = "_", extra = "merge", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(Type = case_when(Type == "deces" ~ "Deces", TRUE ~ "Cas"))

df_final <- tab3 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Disease, Type), names_to = "Week", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(FR = if_else(Cas > 0, Deces / Cas * 100, 0)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cas, Deces, FR), names_to = "metric", values_to = "val") %>%
  unite(col = "week_metric", Week, metric, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week_metric, values_from = val) %>%
  mutate(Disease = case_when(
    Disease == "cholera" ~ "Choléra",
    Disease == "diarrsang" ~ "Diarrhée sanglante",
    Disease == "fhv" ~ "Fièvre hémorragique virale",
    Disease == "mpox" ~ "Mpox",
    Disease == "palu" ~ "Paludisme confirmé",
    Disease == "pfa" ~ "PFA",
    Disease == "rougeole" ~ "Rougeole",
    Disease == "tnn" ~ "Tétanos néonatal",
    TRUE ~ Disease
  )) %>%
  arrange(Disease)

gt_tbl <- df_final %>% gt(rowname_col = "Disease") %>% fmt_number(columns = contains("FR"), decimals = 2)

weeks <- df_final %>% select(-Disease) %>% names() %>% str_remove("_(Cas|Deces|FR)$") %>% unique()
for (wk in weeks) {
  cols_for_week <- df_final %>% select(starts_with(wk)) %>% names()
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% tab_spanner(label = wk, columns = all_of(cols_for_week))
}

col_names <- df_final %>% select(-Disease) %>% names()
new_labels <- ifelse(str_detect(col_names, "_Cas"), "Cas", ifelse(str_detect(col_names, "_Deces"), "Décès", ifelse(str_detect(col_names, "_FR"), "TM (%)", col_names)))
names(new_labels) <- col_names

gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
  cols_label(!!!new_labels) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Surveillance épidémiologique des maladies sous surveillance - Burundi") %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "thistle2"), locations = cells_body(rows = Disease == "Choléra"))
```

**2.2. Tendances entre les deux dernières semaines**

```{r tendances-idsr, include=FALSE}
semaines_disponibles <- MPE_SE %>% filter(semaine != "Total") %>% arrange(semaine) %>% pull(semaine) %>% unique()
sem_prec <- semaines_disponibles[length(semaines_disponibles) - 1]
sem_der <- semaines_disponibles[length(semaines_disponibles)]

col_prec <- paste0(sem_prec, "_Cas")
col_der <- paste0(sem_der, "_Cas")

tendance <- df_final %>%
  select(Disease, all_of(col_prec), all_of(col_der)) %>%
  mutate(tendance = if_else(.data[[col_prec]] == 0, NA_real_, round(((.data[[col_der]] - .data[[col_prec]]) / .data[[col_prec]]) * 100, 0)))


gt_bl_tendance <- tendance %>% gt(rowname_col = "Disease")
semaine<- tendance %>% 
  select(-Disease) %>% 
  names() %>% 
  str_remove("_(Cas)$") %>% 
  unique()

for (wk in weeks) {
  
  # Identifier les colonnes appartenant à la semaine courante.
  colonne_for_week <- tendance %>%
    select(starts_with(wk)) %>%
    names()
  
  # Regrouper les colonnes sous le nom de la semaine.
  gt_bl_tendance <- gt_bl_tendance %>%
    tab_spanner(
      label = wk,
      columns = all_of(colonne_for_week)
    )
}


colonne_names <- tendance %>%
  select(-Disease) %>%
  names()

new_noms <- ifelse(
  str_detect(colonne_names, "_Cas"),

    )
  )

# Associer chaque nouveau libellé à son nom de colonne original.
names(new_noms) <- colonne_names

gt_bl_tendance <- gt_bl_tendance %>%
  
  # Appliquer les libellés Cas, Décès et TM (%).
  cols_label(
    !!!new_noms
  ) %>%
  
  # Ajouter le titre général.
  tab_header(
    title = "Tendance épidémiologique des maladies sous surveillance, entre les 2 dernières SE - Burundi"
  ) %>%
  
  # Centrer le contenu.
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  )
```

```{r fonction-graphique-maladie, include=FALSE}
graphique_maladie <- function(data, variable, titre) {
  data %>%
    select(num_semaine, all_of(variable)) %>%
    group_by(num_semaine) %>%
    summarise(valeur = sum(.data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(week_num = as.integer(num_semaine), semaine = factor(num_semaine, levels = sort(unique(week_num)))) %>%
    arrange(week_num) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = semaine, y = valeur)) +
    geom_col(fill = "midnightblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, width = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = format_fr) +
    labs(title = titre, x = "Semaine épidémiologique", y = "Nombre de cas") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))
}

graph_mpox <- graphique_maladie(idsr, "MPOX_CasSuspect", "Évolution des cas de Mpox, Burundi 2026")
graph_cholera <- graphique_maladie(idsr, "Cholera_CasTraites", "Évolution des cas de Choléra, Burundi 2026")
graph_rougeole <- graphique_maladie(idsr, "rougeole_suspect", "Évolution des cas de Rougeole, Burundi 2026")

```

```{r focus-msf, fig.width=10, fig.height=5, include=FALSE}
# District sanitaire de Cibitoke
names(cibitoke) <- c(
  "aire_sanitaire", "semaine", "Cholera_CasTraites", "cholera_deces",
  "diarrh_sang__traites", "diarrh_sang_deces", "FHV_Test_positif",
  "FHV_Deces", "MPOX_CasSuspect", "PFA_Cas", "PFA_Deces", "palu_positifs",
  "palu_deces", "rougeole_suspect", "rougeole_deces", "TNN_CasSuspect", "TNN_Deces"
)

idsr_cibitoke <- cibitoke %>%
  mutate(
    semaine_originale = semaine,
    num_semaine = as.integer(str_extract(semaine, "(?<=Week\\s)\\d+")),
    date_debut = ymd(str_extract(semaine, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}")),
    date_fin = ymd(str_extract(semaine, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$")),
    annee = year(date_fin)
  ) %>%
  relocate(aire_sanitaire, annee, num_semaine, date_debut, date_fin, semaine_originale)

surveillance_cbtk <- idsr_cibitoke %>%
  select(aire_sanitaire, num_semaine, annee, palu_positifs, palu_deces, rougeole_suspect, rougeole_deces,
         MPOX_CasSuspect, FHV_Test_positif, FHV_Deces, diarrh_sang__traites, diarrh_sang_deces,
         Cholera_CasTraites, cholera_deces, PFA_Cas, PFA_Deces, TNN_CasSuspect, TNN_Deces) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(aire_sanitaire, num_semaine, annee))) %>%
  mutate(semaine = paste0(annee, "-W", sprintf("%02d", num_semaine))) %>%
  select(-annee)


MPE_SE_cbtk <- surveillance_cbtk %>%
  arrange(semaine) %>%
  group_by(semaine) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

total_cas_cbtk <- surveillance_cbtk %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

MPE_SE_cbtk <- bind_rows(MPE_SE_cbtk, total_cas_cbtk) %>%
  mutate(semaine = case_when(is.na(semaine) ~ "Total", TRUE ~ semaine))

SE_3D_cbtk <- bind_rows(
  MPE_SE_cbtk %>% filter(semaine != "Total") %>% arrange(semaine) %>% slice_tail(n = 3),
  MPE_SE_cbtk %>% filter(semaine == "Total")
)

tab1_cbtk <- SE_3D_cbtk %>%
  select(-num_semaine) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -semaine, names_to = "name", values_to = "value")

tab2_cbtk <- tab1_cbtk %>% pivot_wider(names_from = semaine, values_from = value)

tab3_cbtk <- tab2_cbtk %>%
  mutate(
    name = tolower(name),
    name = case_when(
      name == "diarrh_sang__traites" ~ "diarrsang_traites",
      name == "diarrh_sang_deces" ~ "diarrsang_deces",
      TRUE ~ name
    )
  ) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("Disease", "Type"), sep = "_", extra = "merge", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(Type = case_when(Type == "deces" ~ "Deces", TRUE ~ "Cas"))

df_final_cbtk <- tab3_cbtk %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Disease, Type), names_to = "Week", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(FR = if_else(Cas > 0, Deces / Cas * 100, 0)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cas, Deces, FR), names_to = "metric", values_to = "val") %>%
  unite(col = "week_metric", Week, metric, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week_metric, values_from = val) %>%
  mutate(Disease = case_when(
    Disease == "cholera" ~ "Choléra",
    Disease == "diarrsang" ~ "Diarrhée sanglante",
    Disease == "fhv" ~ "Fièvre hémorragique virale",
    Disease == "mpox" ~ "Mpox",
    Disease == "palu" ~ "Paludisme confirmé",
    Disease == "pfa" ~ "PFA",
    Disease == "rougeole" ~ "Rougeole",
    Disease == "tnn" ~ "Tétanos néonatal",
    TRUE ~ Disease
  )) %>%
  arrange(Disease)

gt_tbl_cbtk <- df_final_cbtk %>% gt(rowname_col = "Disease") %>% fmt_number(columns = contains("FR"), decimals = 2)

weeks_cbtk <- df_final_cbtk %>% select(-Disease) %>% names() %>% str_remove("_(Cas|Deces|FR)$") %>% unique()
for (wk in weeks_cbtk) {
  cols_for_week <- df_final_cbtk %>% select(starts_with(wk)) %>% names()
  gt_tbl_cbtk <- gt_tbl_cbtk %>% tab_spanner(label = wk, columns = all_of(cols_for_week))
}

col_names_cbtk <- df_final_cbtk %>% select(-Disease) %>% names()
new_labels_cbtk <- ifelse(str_detect(col_names_cbtk, "_Cas"), "Cas", ifelse(str_detect(col_names_cbtk, "_Deces"), "Décès", ifelse(str_detect(col_names_cbtk, "_FR"), "TM (%)", col_names_cbtk)))
names(new_labels_cbtk) <- col_names_cbtk

gt_tbl_cbtk <- gt_tbl_cbtk %>%
  cols_label(!!!new_labels_cbtk) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Surveillance épidémiologique des maladies sous surveillance - DS Cibitoke") %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "thistle2"), locations = cells_body(rows = Disease == "Choléra"))

# Nombre de cas par semaine au DS de Cibitoke
cas_semaine_cbtk<- MPE_SE_cbtk %>% 
  filter(semaine != "Total")%>%
  mutate(semaine = sub(".*-W", "SE", semaine))

# Représentation graphique
palu_cbtk<- ggplot(cas_semaine_cbtk, aes(x = semaine, y = palu_positifs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7FB8") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(palu_positifs)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Semaine épidémiologique",
    y = "Cas positifs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  labs(
    x = "Semaine épidémiologique",
    y = "Cas suspects de rougeole"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


cholera_cbtk<- ggplot(cas_semaine_cbtk, aes(x = semaine, y = Cholera_CasTraites  )) +

  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(Cholera_CasTraites  )),

# Calcul des Taux d'incidence par AR pour 1000 hbitants
  # Projet Busuma
pop_AR_project<- read_excel("data_for_analysis/pop_AR.xlsx")
pop_AR_ruyigi <- pop_AR_project %>% filter(District_Sanitaire=="Ruyigi") %>% select(Aire_Responsabilite, Population) 
names(pop_AR_ruyigi)<- c("aire_sanitaire", "Population")
cas_DSE_ruyigi<- surveillance_ruyigi %>% filter(num_semaine == max(num_semaine))
pop_AR_ruyigi_cas<- cas_DSE_ruyigi %>% left_join(pop_AR_ruyigi, by = "aire_sanitaire")


last_week_inc_ruyigi <- pop_AR_ruyigi_cas %>%
  select(aire_sanitaire, Population, semaine, palu_positifs, rougeole_suspect, Cholera_CasTraites) %>%
  mutate(
    inci_palu_ruyigi = (palu_positifs / Population) * 1e3,
    inci_rougeole_ruyigi = (rougeole_suspect / Population) * 1e3,
    inci_cholera_ruyigi = (Cholera_CasTraites / Population) * 1e3
  )

# Taux d'incidence du paludisme par AR pour 1000 hbitants
inci_palu_ruyigi <- last_week_inc_ruyigi %>% select(aire_sanitaire, Population, palu_positifs, inci_palu_ruyigi) %>% mutate(across(starts_with("inci_"), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>% arrange(desc(inci_palu_ruyigi)) %>% slice_head(n = 3)

  # Projet Cibitoke-Ndava
```

```{r Carto_projet_MSF, echo=FALSE}

# Projet Paludisme : Cibitoke Ndava

aire_cbtk_ndava<- aire_zone_projet %>% 
  filter(ds== "Cibitoke" | ds== "Ndava")
  
  
merge1 <- cas_DSE_cbk_ndava %>% left_join(aire_cbtk_ndava, by = "aire_sanitaire")

cas_zones_cbtk <- merge1 %>%
  select(palu_positifs, ZONES)  %>%
  group_by(ZONES) %>%
    summarise(cas = sum(palu_positifs, na.rm = T))

names(cas_zones_cbtk)<- c("ZONES", "cas")
# last_week_pop <- last_week %>% left_join(pop, by = "districts")
  

merge2<- cas_zones_cbtk %>% left_join(zone_cbtk_ndava, by = "ZONES")
merge2 <- sf::st_as_sf(merge2)

brks_incidPCN <- quantile(merge2$cas, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 6), na.rm = TRUE) %>% unique() %>% as.numeric()

Carte_palu_cbtk_ndava <- tmap::tm_shape(merge2) +
  tmap::tm_polygons(col = "cas", palette = "Reds", style = "fixed", breaks = brks_incidPCN, title = "Cas de Palu notifié +", textNA = "") +
  tmap::tm_borders(col = "grey40") +
  tmap::tm_text(text = "ZONES", size = 0.6, col = "black", shadow = TRUE, remove.overlap = TRUE) +
  tmap::tm_compass(type = "arrow", position = c("left", "top"), size = 2) +
  tmap::tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"), text.size = 0.7) +
  tmap::tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE, frame = FALSE, main.title = paste0("Cas positifs de paludisme par Zone adminstrative du DS de Cibitoke et Ndava"), 
                  main.title.size = 1)


# Projet Refugiés congolais Ruyigi
aire_ruyigi<- aire_zone_projet %>% 
  filter(ds== "Ruyigi")

merge3 <- cas_DSE_ruyigi %>% left_join(aire_ruyigi, by = "aire_sanitaire")

cas_zones_ruyigi <- merge3 %>%
  select(palu_positifs, ZONES)  %>%
  group_by(ZONES) %>%
    summarise(cas = sum(palu_positifs, na.rm = T))

# Fusion avec la base shapefile
merge4<- cas_zones_ruyigi %>% left_join(zone_ruyigi, by = "ZONES")
merge4 <- sf::st_as_sf(merge4)
 # Carte des cas par zones admin
   # classe en quintil
brks_incidRuy <- quantile(merge4$cas, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 6), na.rm = TRUE) %>% unique() %>% as.numeric()

Carte_palu_rugigi <- tmap::tm_shape(merge4) +
  tmap::tm_polygons(col = "cas", palette = "Reds", style = "fixed", breaks = brks_incidRuy, title = "Cas de Palu notifié +", textNA = "") +
  tmap::tm_borders(col = "grey40") +
  tmap::tm_text(text = "ZONES", size = 0.6, col = "black", shadow = TRUE, remove.overlap = TRUE) +
  tmap::tm_compass(type = "arrow", position = c("left", "top"), size = 2) +
  tmap::tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"), text.size = 0.7) +
  tmap::tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE, frame = FALSE, main.title = paste0("Cas positifs de paludisme par Zone adminstrative du DS de Ruyigi"), 
                  main.title.size = 1)
```
